newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Hyundai Oil in Daqing crude term deal.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Hyundai Oil in Daqing crude term deal.

text.p: South Korea's Hyundai Oil Refinery Co said it signed a long term contract with China Oil on Thursday to import Chinese Daqing crude.
The first shipments arrived last month, before the contract was completed.
A Hyundai statement said it was the company's first term commitment for Chinese crude.

Hyundai traders said one cargo of Daqing crude would be shipped each month until the end of this year. The deal would be reviewed after one year and could be extended. A total of four million barrels would arrive this year.
The traders said the price would be set every month.
Hyundai paid $18.88 per barrel FOB for shipment last month, they said.
The Hyundai statement said Daqing oil was low in sulphur. The deal was in line with South Korea's tougher environmental regulations.
